title: [Epic] ADR-0025 plugin package distribution — the next development phase: M0 record v2, M1 local T0 install loop (first-party, self-signed), M2 cloud fetch + per-plugin permission enforcement, M3 third-party sandbox tier
body:
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. The maintainer, in the director summon chat on 2026-10-28, on ADR batch 4 (objectstack#26553): 「ADR-0025 插件包分发（代码 + 依赖）（2026-05，2026-09-12 审计） 应该是下一阶段的重点开发，需要综合评估和我沟通」; after the seat's assessment (code inventory on objectstack `f2fdac5d7a` and cloud `ce05c91`, decision points Q1–Q8): 「插件包分发 同意，应该立专题卡吧？」. Filed by the director seat (`session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ No `domain:*`: the children span `cli`, `server` (core/runtime), `cloud` and `spec`; triage sets each child's lane. Dedupe: #17757 (closed, "ADR-0025 install-flow design"), #13457 (closed, F4 load-time registration), the retired #17147 / #11333 numbers in code comments; no open card carries the install loop. **New.**

## 维护者速读

ADR-0025 今天是「造得出、签得了、发得上去，但装不进来、跑不起来、拦不住」：供给侧（`.osplugin` 格式、`os plugin build/sign/publish`、云端审核与反签、安装时授权同意）完整；需求侧从 §3.5 第 4 步起不存在——没有 `os plugin install`、没有 `.osplugin` 加载器、云端没有 blob 下载路由、授权集只登记不拦截（pin test 钉着）、信任层 T0/T1/T2 只是枚举。本专题按你同意的席位倾向分四期（M0–M3），每期立子卡；M0 先改记录，再按 v2 开工。

## The decisions this epic carries (the maintainer's 「同意」 to the seat's inclinations, 2026-10-28)

| # | Question | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| Q1 first consumer | who does the next phase close the loop for | **first-party drivers / connectors (T0, self-signed)**; the cloud `plugins/connector-stripe` sample is the acceptance case; third parties wait for M3 |
| Q2 local-first | local install before cloud fetch | **local first** (`os plugin install ./x.osplugin`, ADR-0016 §9 parity); the cloud blob download route follows in M2 |
| Q3 trust tier | which tiers in M1 | **T0 only** (`node`, first-party / verified), with the tier dispatch point left in the loader for T1 in M3 |
| Q4 enforcement | per-plugin `SecurePluginContext` | **M2, before any third-party load**; services + hooks are enforced; the `fs` / `network` classes keep their schema and get their enforce-or-remove decision in M3 (no production call surface today) |
| Q5 registry | `sys_plugin*` vs `sys_package*` | **accept the fold into `sys_package*`**; v2 rewrites §3.8 |
| Q6 dependencies | manifest-deps | **drop it; bundled only** (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove; build-side half with zero installers) |
| Q7 §3.10 #4 / #5 | RLS-scoped grants, secret-refs | **secret-refs only, when the first real connector needs them** (M3); RLS-scoped grants stay a design note |
| Q8 §7 open questions | key rotation, widening UX, hot vs boot, T2 RPC, dependency conflicts | widening UX = the shipped 409 re-consent, not activated before consent; hot reload retired with #12587 → boot activation; key rotation, T2 RPC and dependency conflicts deferred to M3 |

## Milestones (each a child card; `Blocked-by:` chains as listed)

- **M0 — ADR-0025 v2** (`docs/adr/**`, Tier H, one PR). Rewrite the four stale sections (§3.8 registry → `sys_package*`; §3.4 endpoint `/cloud/packages`; §3.3 esbuild; §3.10 L1 = script bodies + QuickJS, already live), fold Q1–Q8 in, split §3.5 steps 4–7 into dispatchable sub-steps, and set the status line: Accepted — narrowed to Phase 1 + consent + the M0–M3 plan. Authoring is open to every seat; the director seat drafts it unless triage routes otherwise.
- **M1 — local T0 install loop** (`Blocked-by:` M0). (a) `os plugin install ./x.osplugin`: whole-artifact Ed25519 verification against the host's trusted keys (`verifyPluginArtifact`, today 0 callers) + per-file `integrity` re-verification at unpack, materialize to `<OS_HOME>/plugins/<env>/<id>/<version>/`, write the installation record, `--trust-unsigned` dev override; (b) the loader: scan installed plugins at boot, dynamic-import `dist/index.mjs`, reuse `plugin-loader.ts` dependency ordering, tier dispatch point (T0 only), disable/uninstall through the package disable-state store; (c) Stripe sample as the e2e acceptance; (d) delete the "NOT RE-VERIFIED AT UNPACK" / "no `os plugin install`" self-descriptions the code carries today. Lanes: `cli`, `server`. ⛔ M1 is first-party / self-signed only and is not listed in any marketplace surface.
- **M2 — cloud fetch + enforcement** (`Blocked-by:` M1). (a) cloud `GET …/artifact` serves the `.osplugin` blob with publisher + platform signatures; `os plugin install <id>@<version>` walks resolve → compat → consent → download; (b) per-plugin `SecurePluginContext` scoped to the granted set for services and hooks (`PluginContext` wrap at §3.5 step 7), delete `granted-permissions-not-enforced.pin.test.ts` and the `PluginDisclosure.tsx:148` sentence in the same PR. Lanes: `cloud`, `server`.
- **M3 — third-party tier** (`Blocked-by:` M2). T1 dispatch to QuickJS for `runtime:'sandbox'`; publish-side secret / vulnerability scan; secret-refs to the settings/KV store; the `fs` / `network` enforce-or-remove decision; key rotation, T2 RPC and dependency-conflict answers. Lanes: `cloud`, `server`, `spec`.

## Risks the children inherit

- M1's T0 is "author code in the host process": hard-limited to first-party / self-signed; written into v2 as a ⛔.
- Every landed step deletes its matching "NOT ENFORCED" / "not verified" self-description and pin; leaving one makes the gates red and the record false.
- Scope: UI plugins (ADR-0026, Deferred) and the declarative connector sub-path (ADR-0023/0024) stay out; `.osplugin` serves plugins that need npm dependencies or host APIs.

## Done-when

- M0 v2 merged; ADR-0025's status line reads Accepted (narrowed) with the M1–M3 plan.
- M1: a self-signed `.osplugin` installs locally, loads at boot, runs the Stripe sample end to end, disables cleanly.
- M2: the same plugin installs from the cloud registry and a denied service/hook call is refused and logged.
- M3: an unverified publisher's `runtime:'sandbox'` plugin runs under QuickJS; the pin tests and self-descriptions listed above are gone.

## Related

ADR-0025 (record), ADR-0019 §Out-of-scope (the "load-bearing wall"), ADR-0016 §9 (local-first), ADR-0049 (enforce-or-remove), #26553 (ADR batch 4 ruling), #17757 (closed design card), #13457 (F4 registration), cloud `plugins/connector-stripe`.
